dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular closed and semi-closed loops with high-intensity light-gray perimeters and sharp transitions to low-intensity dark-gray interiors; edge geometry is predominantly jagged with variable thickness across the most prominent structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters lacking an internal gradient, distributed primarily in the interstitial spaces between major annuli in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-body annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, while a sequence of smaller posterior annuli forms a roughly linear chain along the lateral axis.
